descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: real-device variant.

Bug B18 · S1 · known

Many dates and times follow the device clock instead of server time (UAT 3.8): 'NEW TODAY', admit date, vitals date, task done time, transcript date; with a phone two days slow a held drug is stamped two days back and the next cleanup deletes it

Tickets: TFA-92584 ready for qa (UAT 3.8); TFA-92597 ready for qa (R6); TFA-92579 AC 3/4 ready for qa (NEW TODAY); TFA-94745 ready for qa (draft restore) · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local

Note: Root cause known (Daniela asked for server time on 10-03); the deleted drug, missing badge and wrong draft restore are new symptoms. TC-16/S18 (UAT 3.8, one device set to the wrong date): a phone a day ahead files its bedside line in a row dated tomorrow on the shared record, and the next write from a correctly clocked device lists the lines before it twice (the transcript archive trusts the device date). Which calendar day a correct device should use when its local day and the server's UTC day differ is the open question Q9 (D10); TC-16/S25 passed otherwise. Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92579/92584): a browser whose day is ahead writes the badge roll back to the server, and every device shows Follow-up, with the matching template and billing family (TC-01/S08, TC-20/S20a; TFA-92584 AC 8). The failing cell of TC-25/S24a is the card's NEW TODAY, which compares addedAt with the device's date (PatientCard.tsx:154-156). EFS/S28 (a)(b) restore drafts by the device date (TFA-94745); (c), an old draft put in today's box, is B13's. Review 2026-10-15 (TFA-94514): the analytics day is the device date too (pilotUsageEvents / pilotDailyRounding use localDay()): a phone 3 days ahead files its rows under its own day, and an encounter across the phone midnight is split over two days and never timed (OAT-06/S10). Re-test 2026-10-16 (TC-21/S26, 25acd727): a browser two days ahead writes the badge roll with its own future day (encTypeDay 2026-10-19) to the shared record, so the correct-clock browser shows Follow-up too. Re-test 2026-10-20 on 8b4be94a: changed: task done time and Important Points now use server time (TC-22/S23, TC-12/S23, TC-07/S28 stamp); still device time: Tomorrow's Pre-Round Summary edit (TC-17/S25), task screen header date (TC-07/S28), handoff title date (TC-08/S20), medicationsUpdatedAt (TC-19/S19), NEW TODAY (TC-01/S08), completeEncounter day (OAT-06/S10).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-01/S08, TC-10/S22, TC-12/S23, TC-19/S19, TC-22/S23, TC-25/S24a, TC-02/S13b, EFS/S28, TC-16/S18, TC-06/S19, OAT-06/S10, TC-06/S23, TC-21/S22, TC-25/S24b, TC-21/S26, TC-17/S25, TC-07/S28, TC-08/S20

Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S23 Real dictation of medication changes on iPhone and Android, both contexts

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U18 The step mix (starts, holds, stops, dose changes, conditional orders, one-time doses) is dictated across two days and passes in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-19 Steps; UAT 3.3)
  • U21 Each run records which model did the pre-round processing and the medication-event extraction (and the speech-to-text engine for dictation), and logs the AI call's own time separately from the total. (UAT 3.1; UAT 3.5; UAT 3.9)
  • U23 Server day for the dates the tracker writes: a hold/stop/start tag ('Held · Mon D'), a row's updatedAt and the chart's medicationsUpdatedAt follow the server's day and time, whatever the device clock … (UAT 3.8; TFA-92597 R6 (hold/stop keeps its date))

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Debug builds from round-companion-wt-qa on real phones, pointed at the local stack (.env.mobile.local VITE_CONVEX_URL = the Mac's LAN address on port 4510; Android emulator 10.0.2.2:4510; capacitor.config.ts says LAN backends belong there), signed in to an e2e-fresh @roundai.test account. …

When Dictate S07's encounter text (Hospital) and S08's save-2 text (Nursing Home) with the microphone, then Save & Extract / Save Note. Last line (moved from S19): set one phone's date 2 days back and its time zone to UTC-10, Save & Extract 'Hold lisinopril, BP soft.' and compare the Held tag with the server's day

Then Drug names and numbers transcribed correctly; the tracker and panel end as in S07 / S08; the speech-to-text engine used is recorded (GPT-Live; Deepgram only with ambient on); the wrong-clock phone shows the server's date on the Held tag

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Tester compares the transcript and rows with S07/S08's expected results; engine from the run log (3.9). Any run that would need the store build or the dev deployment is not done here: it needs Quinn's explicit go first (needs-dev-or-prod)

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S23 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-19.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.
